answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy relies on cryptoeconomic identity staking. Each agent must lock a minimum token collateral to assert a unique identity, establishing an economic disincentive for replication. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities would face a cost that would spiral exponentially, akin to an umber wave overwhelming a digital meadow, demanding prohibitive capital proportional to the desired Sybil count.
